name: system-map
description: A live map of your system. Every view reads one model built from your repo, and agents read it through small slices instead of loading it all.
author: System Map contributors
highlights: One model of your repo: modules, routes, tables, plans, risk, worktrees and agents
Every number held to the tool that owns it: the compiler, real Postgres, real SQLite, git
Agents read the model in small slices through MCP tools, so a chat doesn't fill up
Risk ranks code that changes often, has many paths and few tests
Worktrees shows where two branches conflict, from a real trial merge
What-ifs show what Postgres will refuse before you write the migration
The Agents tab shows what starts each agent, who it hands work to, and where its models run
Read only: it never writes to your repo or runs your code
